verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships an official MCP server, so an AI assistant can work inside the workspace from natural-language prompts. The documented actions cover listing audits and evidence requests and adding comments, attachments and status updates. The AI Helpbot only answers documentation questions and does not operate the product. The documented scope is narrow and depends on an external AI assistant as the client. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control over controls, risks, policies and monitors; a native in-app command interface; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
"What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?"
Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
